entry_rule.entry_description: Short GBPUSD M15 only when hour_session=Off_hours and the exact feature condition is true

risk_reward.timeout_note: Close/evaluate after h10 is reached in all cases if neither TP nor SL is hit first

demo_risk_controls.risk_per_trade_note: 1% legacy paper-only simulation note; not the canonical demo execution risk. Approval, request construction, order_check, and order_send sizing must use config/fixed_candidate_demo_execution_policy.json (0.5% / 5 EUR cap).
demo_risk_controls.max_daily_stop_note: No fixed daily stop for initial paper/demo monitoring; daily PnL must still be logged
demo_risk_controls.max_weekly_stop_note: No fixed weekly stop for initial paper/demo monitoring; weekly PnL must still be logged
demo_risk_controls.max_open_positions_note: Maximum 1 open paper/demo trade at a time
demo_risk_controls.max_daily_trades_note: No fixed max daily trade count; signals remain limited by the one-open-trade rule and logging requirements

spread_and_session_controls.spread_threshold_note: TEST VARIANT: skip new paper/demo signals if broker spread exceeds 20 broker points (about 2.0 pips on GBPUSD 5-digit symbols).

kill_switch.kill_switch_note: Disable new paper/demo signals if required data is missing, required features are missing, spread is abnormal or not yet configured, ATR calculation fails, timeframe/session mismatch occurs, or an existing paper/demo trade is already open

logging.logging_note: Log timestamp, symbol, timeframe, feature values, regime value, spread, cost profile, signal state, entry/exit reason, R/net_R, bars held, errors, skipped reasons, daily paper PnL, weekly paper PnL, and kill-switch state

paper_broker_mode.paper_broker_mode_note: Paper logging now; demo broker preparation later

manual_review.manual_review_note: Temporary spread-threshold test config for 20 broker points. Do not treat as canonical until replay/review/cost/holdout artifacts are compared.
